info.description: REST API for the EventHub platform
info.title: EventHub API

get.description: Returns service health status

Returns a database page of shared users ordered by userId ascending, with their current global roles. Only users on this page are looked up in Keycloak, with at most four concurrent lookups and a 15-second total role-lookup timeout. Available only to global admins. total counts all database users; concurrent user creation or deletion can cause count/page differences.
Returns the effective global roles for a user. Available only to global admins.

put.description: Replaces the user's global roles with the submitted set. Only global admins may perform this change; the change is applied in Keycloak and takes effect after a fresh token or login.

post.description: Storniert eine Buchung des Aufrufers und gibt deren Tickets frei. Eine Reservierung ohne Zahlung ist ein Warenkorb-Item und wird für sich storniert. Eine Buchung mit Zahlung wird mit dem ganzen Zahlungsvorgang storniert: Während die Zahlung offen ist, wird der gesamte Checkout storniert — es wurde nichts abgebucht — und nachdem sie bezahlt wurde, wird der Zeilenbetrag der Buchung zurückerstattet; der Zahlungsvorgang gilt als erstattet, sobald alle seine Buchungen storniert sind. Eine bezahlte Buchung einer vom Veranstalter abgesagten Veranstaltung ist nicht stornierbar (409), die Erstattung übernimmt der Veranstalter. Wiederholtes Stornieren gelingt ohne weitere Erstattung.

409.description: Buchung in diesem Status nicht stornierbar oder Veranstaltung vom Veranstalter abgesagt

post.description: Creates an in-app reminder for an own confirmed booking of an upcoming published event. scheduledAt is 24 hours before the event or now for short-notice bookings. Simulation displays it immediately. Repeated calls refresh the existing reminder from current event data. Changed reminders become unread. No email or external delivery service is used. Foreign bookings return 404.

get.description: Liefert den Warenkorb des Aufrufers: jede lebende Reservierung ohne Zahlung mit der aktuellen Verfügbarkeit und den aktuellen Preisen ihres Events. Reservierungen halten ihre Plätze bis expiresAt; danach sind sie nicht mehr Teil des Warenkorb. totalAmount ist die Summe der aktuellen Zeilenbeträge — der Checkout berechnet und speichert den zu zahlenden Betrag selbst. checkoutReady ist nur true, wenn der Warenkorb Items hat und alle Events noch veröffentlicht sind. openPayment nennt den offenen Zahlungsvorgang des Aufrufers, falls einer existiert: Dessen Items haben den Warenkorb verlassen und warten auf ihre Zahlung — sie halten ihre Plätze bis expiresAt — und neue Items können erst ausgecheckt werden, wenn der Vorgang abgeschlossen ist.

delete.description: Entfernt alle Warenkorb-Items des Aufrufers und gibt deren Plätze sofort frei. Reservierungen mit offener Zahlung gehören nicht zum Warenkorb und bleiben unberührt.

post.description: Überführt alle lebenden Reservierungen des Aufrufers in einen Zahlungsvorgang: ein Zahlung mit dem Summenbetrag und pro Item ein Betrag aus Ticketanzahl mal aktuellem Event-Preis, alles serverseitig berechnet und gespeichert; Beträge vom Client werden ignoriert. Alle Buchungen teilen sich eine erneuerte Reservierungsfrist (15 Minuten) — die Zahlung muss vor expiresAt abgeschlossen werden. Items mit abgelaufener Reservierung halten keine Plätze und werden ausgelassen; ist kein Item mehr lebend, liefert der Aufruf 409 bzw. 422 bei leerem Warenkorb. Ein Event, das nicht mehr veröffentlicht ist, lässt den gesamten Checkout scheitern (409), weil die Zahlung alle Items zusammen oder gar nicht abschließt. Existiert bereits ein offener Zahlungsvorgang, wird dieser unverändert zurückgegeben (200).

409.description: Reservierungen abgelaufen oder Event nicht mehr verfügbar

post.description: Reserviert Tickets eines veröffentlichten Events für den AufrufER und legt sie damit in den Warenkorb. Die Reservierung hält die Plätze bis expiresAt (15 Minuten) und verfällt danach. Existiert bereits ein Item für das Event, wächst dessen Anzahl (höchstens 10 pro Event) und die Reservierung wird erneuert; ein abgelaufenes Item wird ersetzt. Der Platz wird wie bei einer Buchung sofort gegen die Kapazität geprüft (409). Die Antwort ist der Warenkorb nach der Änderung.

409.description: Event nicht veröffentlicht oder Kapazität überschritten

422.description: Mehr als 10 Tickets für ein Event

delete.description: Entfernt ein eigenes Warenkorb-Item (Reservierung ohne Zahlung) und gibt dessen Plätze sofort frei. Abgelaufene, ausgecheckte, stornierte oder fremde Items liefern 404. Die Antwort ist der Warenkorb nach der Änderung.

parameters.description: ID der Reservierung hinter dem Item
parameters.name: bookingId

patch.description: Setzt die Ticketanzahl eines eigenen Warenkorb-Items (Reservierung ohne Zahlung). Das Item behält seine reservierten Plätze, mehr Tickets brauchen freie Plätze (409); die Reservierung wird erneuert. Abgelaufene, ausgecheckte, stornierte oder fremde Items liefern 404. Die Antwort ist der Warenkorb nach der Änderung.

parameters.description: ID der Reservierung hinter dem Item
parameters.name: bookingId

post.description: TEST ONLY — accepts username/password and returns a Keycloak access token. Disabled in production (requires DEBUG_ENABLED=true).

get.description: Public list of published events with their category, location and organizer alias. Optional location searches the city and the address addition of the location; categoryId selects an exact category. date selects a calendar day in Europe/Berlin (YYYY-MM-DD) and returns every event taking place during that day, including multi-day events that span it. All filters are combined using AND. Omit a filter or pass an empty value to reset it. Unknown categories and searches without matches return 200 with []. Invalid dates, invalid category UUIDs or location values exceeding 200 characters after trimming return 400. Events missing a category, location or organizer are omitted. Sorted by start time and event ID.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the city or the address addition of the location; trimmed, empty means no filter, maximum 200 characters. Wildcards are treated literally.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Exact category UUID; trimmed, empty means no category filter. Combined with location using AND.
parameters.name: categoryId

parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in Europe/Berlin. Events taking place during this calendar day are returned, including multi-day events that span it. Empty means no date filter.
parameters.name: date

post.description: Creates an event in status draft. Drafts are only visible to the organization that owns them and can be edited (PUT /events/{id}) and published (POST /events/{id}/publish) later. Requires the event_manager role in the owning organization. organizationId is the Keycloak organization ID or alias as returned by GET /users/me; it may be omitted when the caller manages events in exactly one organization. location holds the address fields; the event is linked to the stored location with the same address (compared case-insensitively), which is created if there is none. GET /locations lists existing locations to fill the fields.

get.description: Returns all events of the organization, in every status including drafts. The organization is addressed by its database UUID or by its alias, which is what tokens carry. Requires membership in the organization, regardless of role. Organizations the caller is not a member of return 404, like unknown ones.

200.description: Events of the organization; an empty array if there are none

get.description: Returns the events of all organizations in which the caller holds the event_manager role, ordered by start time. Use status=draft to list the own drafts. Drafts are never visible to other organizations or visitors.

parameters.description: Only return events in this status
parameters.name: status

200.description: Own events; an empty array if there are none

get.description: Public event details with description, category, location, organizer alias, price, capacity, availableSeats and bookable. Available seats account for confirmed tickets and unexpired reservations. soldTickets counts confirmed tickets; occupancyPercent is their share of capacity, rounded to two decimals and capped at 100. availability is available, almost_sold_out (at least 90% confirmed and still bookable), sold_out (confirmed tickets exhaust capacity), or temporarily_unavailable (live reservations block booking). Sold-out published events remain visible with bookable=false. Booking via POST /bookings requires authentication and checks availability again. Unpublished events and events missing category, location or organizer return 404.
Returns the remaining available seats for an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

Public average score and review count. Only visible ratings with scores 1–5 linked to confirmed bookings of this event count; ticket quantities do not weight reviews. No valid ratings returns averageRating=null and ratingCount=0. Published events and ended completed events expose summaries; drafts and cancelled events return 404. Averages are not rounded.
Returns the number of confirmed tickets sold for an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

Returns the share of the capacity taken by confirmed bookings, in percent with two decimals and capped at 100; 0 if the capacity is 0. Reserved and cancelled bookings are not counted. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

put.description: Updates title, description, time span, location, category, price and capacity of an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status draft or published can be edited. The capacity cannot be lowered below the tickets already sold or reserved (409). A changed address links the event to the stored location with that address, created if there is none; locations themselves are never changed, so other events at the previous address are not affected.

409.description: Capacity below the tickets already sold or reserved

delete.description: Irrevocably deletes a draft event. Requires the event_manager or org_admin role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status draft can be deleted; published, cancelled and completed events return 400. Events with bookings in any status are never deleted and return 409, because the bookings belong to the booking history of the visitors. The audit log entries of the event are kept.

post.description: Publishes a draft event so that visitors can find and book it. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only sufficiently complete events in status draft can be published. If the event is already published, returns 400 with detail "this event is already published".

Creates one rating per authenticated visitor and event. The visitor must have a confirmed booking for this event, and the event must have ended without being cancelled. Text is optional (at most 2000 characters); score must be between 1 and 5. Ratings are visible immediately.

Withdraws a published event so that it is no longer bookable. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status published can be withdrawn; the event status becomes cancelled. If the event has not begun yet, every user with a confirmed booking receives one in-app notification (occasion event_cancelled, eventId set, bookingId null) covering all of their confirmed bookings of the event, and the reminders of the event are deleted. notifiedUsers counts the notified users. Bookings and payments stay unchanged; the notification tells the users that the organizer will contact them about the refund. The status change, notifications and audit entry are saved together or not at all.

get.description: Returns the stored locations an organizer can pick to fill the address fields of an event: the locations of all events that are no drafts and of every event of the organizations in which the caller holds the event_manager role. Locations used only by drafts of other organizations are not listed. Saving an event with the same address, compared case-insensitively, reuses the location; any other address creates a new one. Locations are never changed. Sorted by city, street, house number and address addition.

200.description: Selectable locations; an empty array if there are none

get.description: Liefert alle Buchungen des Aufrufers in jedem Status, die neueste zuerst, mit Event, Ort, Ticketanzahl, Buchungs- und Zahlungsstatus, failureReason und ticketsValid. bookingStatus ist der gespeicherte Status, nur eine nach der Datenbankuhr abgelaufene Reservierung wird als expired angezeigt. GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment zeigt dagegen den gespeicherten Status reserved, bei offener Zahlung bis zum Cleanup der Zahlungen nach höchstens etwa einer Minute; ohne Zahlung liefert es 404. status filtert auf den angezeigten Status, expired findet also gespeicherte und abgeleitete abgelaufene Buchungen. Ein leeres Array, wenn es keine Buchungen gibt.

parameters.description: Nur Buchungen mit diesem angezeigten Status
parameters.name: status

403.description: Nutzer nicht in der API-Datenbank synchronisiert

get.description: Liefert eine Buchung des Aufrufers in jedem Status mit Event, Ort, Ticketanzahl, Buchungsstatus, Zahlungsstatus, Betrag, failureReason und ticketsValid. Ungültige, stornierte oder abgelaufene Buchungen sowie Tickets abgesagter Events sind mit ticketsValid false markiert. ticketsValid, paymentStatus, failureReason und message entsprechen GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment, weil beide dieselbe Regel und dieselben Texte nutzen. bookingStatus zeigt eine nach der Datenbankuhr abgelaufene Reservierung als expired, GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment den gespeicherten Status, bei offener Zahlung bis zum Cleanup nach höchstens etwa einer Minute. Unbekannte Buchungen und Buchungen anderer Nutzer liefern beide 404.

403.description: Nutzer nicht in der API-Datenbank synchronisiert

404.description: Buchung unbekannt oder von einem anderen Nutzer

get.description: Liefert die gültigen und die stornierten Tickets des Aufrufers. Gültig sind Buchungen mit ticketsValid true, also bezahlt, bestätigt und für ein veröffentlichtes oder abgeschlossenes Event. Storniert sind bezahlte Tickets mit cancelledBy: organizer, wenn der Veranstalter das Event abgesagt hat, oder user, wenn der Aufrufer die Buchung nach der Bezahlung storniert hat; sie haben ticketsValid false. Warenkorb-Reservierungen und vor der Bezahlung abgebrochene Checkouts erscheinen nicht. Kommende Events zuerst nach Startzeit aufsteigend, danach vergangene nach Startzeit absteigend; ein Event gilt als kommend, bis es nach der Datenbankuhr geendet hat. Jeder Eintrag enthält bookingId für GET /me/bookings/{bookingId} und ratingScore, den Score, mit dem der Aufrufer das Event bewertet hat, oder null, wenn noch nicht bewertet; die Bewertung zählt pro Nutzer und Event. Ticketliste, Buchungshistorie, Ticketdetails und GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment wenden dieselbe Gültigkeitsregel an. Ein leeres Array, wenn es weder gültige noch stornierte Tickets gibt.

403.description: Nutzer nicht in der API-Datenbank synchronisiert

get.description: Returns a page of all ratings including their text, newest first, with event and organization. Requires the global role admin or moderator. Unlike the public summaries, hidden ratings and ratings of any booking status are included; hidden filters by visibility, eventId by rated event. eventId, eventTitle, organizationId and organizationName are null if the rating no longer belongs to an event or organization. Hidden ratings are released with PUT /moderation/ratings/{ratingId}/visibility and hidden=false.

parameters.description: Only hidden (true) or only visible (false) ratings
parameters.name: hidden

put.description: Hides (hidden=true) a rating or releases it again (hidden=false), which withdraws an earlier hiding. Requires the global role admin or moderator. Hidden ratings no longer count towards rating summaries and recommendations. The reason (1-1000 characters after trimming) is required and is stored with the acting user in the audit log of the organization that owns the rated event (organization_id "platform" if the rating no longer belongs to an organization). Requesting the current visibility returns changed=false and records nothing.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's notifications, newest first. The response contains items, page, limit and total; empty pages return items: []. readAt is null for unread notifications. Simulated reminder content and scheduledAt are refreshed from current event and location data before display; changed reminders become unread. Simulation is immediately visible, even before scheduledAt; no email is sent. Cancellation notices (occasion event_cancelled, EVENTHUB-291) are created when an upcoming event with own confirmed bookings is withdrawn; they reference the event via eventId, their scheduledAt is the time of the withdrawal and they are not refreshed.

patch.description: Idempotently sets readAt. Foreign and unknown notifications return 404. Changed simulated reminders become unread again on their next refresh.

post.description: Creates a new organization in Keycloak and the API database. Requires the admin role on the backend client.

get.description: Returns the audit log of an organization, newest entries first: who (personal account) changed what and when. Covers event changes (including price changes, publishing and cancellation) and changes of member roles. Requires the org_admin role in the given organization (global admins bypass this check). organizationID is the Keycloak organization ID or alias. Entries of operations in Keycloak consist of a "started" entry and a "succeeded" or "incomplete" entry with the same operationId; a "started" entry without a result means the outcome is unconfirmed. Entries are deleted ten years after they were recorded. Use nextCursor from the response as cursor to get the next page.

Returns sales figures for events of the selected organization. Requires the finance_viewer role in that organization. The organization can be addressed by its local UUID, Keycloak ID or alias. Sold tickets count only confirmed bookings. Available seats are capacity minus confirmed tickets, with a minimum of zero. Returns an empty array if the organization has no events.

parameters.description: Organization UUID, Keycloak ID or alias
parameters.name: organizationID

put.description: Replaces the complete role set of an organization member. Requires the org_admin role in the given organization (global admins bypass this check); it is checked against the token and again against Keycloak, so a demoted admin cannot act on an old token. organizationID is the Keycloak organization ID or alias as returned by POST /organizations and GET /users/me. roles is required; an empty array removes all roles. Roles: org_admin (manage members), event_manager (manage events), finance_viewer (view sales and billing). Removing the last org_admin is rejected. The affected user must refresh their token before the new roles take effect.

parameters.description: Complete role set for the member (empty array = no roles)
parameters.name: request

get.description: Public average of unrounded event averages, with equal weight per rated event. Includes only this organization's published or completed events with endTime <= database time. Uses the same visible, score 1–5, confirmed-booking ratings as event summaries. Unrated events do not contribute. No rated events returns averageRating=null and ratedEventCount=0. Recommendations retain their existing calculation.

parameters.description: Organization database UUID (not Keycloak ID or alias)
parameters.name: organizationID

get.description: Liefert den gespeicherten Zahlungsvorgang des Aufrufers: den Summenbetrag, den Zahlungsstatus und jedes Item mit Event, Ticketanzahl, Zeilenbetrag, Buchungsstatus und Ticketgültigkeit. Der Zahlungsvorgang deckt alle Buchungen eines Warenkorb-Checkouts ab und schließt sie zusammen ab. ticketsValid ist nur true, wenn die Zahlung bezahlt, alle Buchungen bestätigt sind und die Events stattfinden oder stattgefunden haben. Zahlung, Buchungen, Event-Status und Datenbankuhr stammen aus einer Abfrage. Offene Zahlungen abgelaufener Reservierungen schließt ein Hintergrundjob jede Minute als fehlgeschlagen ab. Zahlungsvorgänge anderer Nutzer liefern 404.

post.description: Schließt den offenen Zahlungsvorgang des Aufrufers mit einem simulierten Ergebnis ab; es ist kein echter Zahlungsdienstleister angebunden. amount muss dem gespeicherten Summenbetrag entsprechen, sonst wird nichts geändert (422). Bei success werden alle Buchungen des Zahlungsvorgangs verbindlich bestätigt (bookingStatus confirmed, ticketsValid true). Bei failure, abgelaufener Reservierung oder nicht mehr verfügbarem Event schlägt die Zahlung fehl (status failed, failureReason, message), keine Buchung erhält einen Ticketanspruch und alle Tickets werden freigegeben — der Zahlungsvorgang gilt für alle Buchungen zusammen oder für keine. Das Ergebnis wird innerhalb der Transaktion aus dem gespeicherten Zahlungsstatus gelesen. Der Body darf höchstens 4 KiB groß sein (413).

200.description: Ergebnis des Zahlungsvorgangs, erfolgreich oder fehlgeschlagen

409.description: Zahlung bereits abgeschlossen oder Buchung nicht reserviert

422.description: Betrag weicht vom gespeicherten Betrag ab

get.description: Returns future published events with free capacity, excluding the user's confirmed bookings. Active reservations count toward capacity. Ranking weights category affinity (50%), confirmed ticket popularity (40%), and organizer ratings (10%).

parameters.description: Maximum number of recommendations after ranking; omitted returns all recommendations
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile, global roles, active organization, and organization memberships

amount.description:
Amount shown to the user before completing the payment, as JSON number or string; it must
equal the stored amount.

outcome.description: Outcome the simulated payment provider reports; no real payment provider is connected.

lineAmount.description:
LineAmount is what the booking costs within its payment: its tickets times the event
price at checkout time. Null while the reservation sits in the cart without a payment.

availableSeats.description:
Seats free for others plus the seats this item holds: the most tickets the item can have.
The reservation itself always keeps its tickets until it expires.

bookable.description: False when the event is no longer published; such an item blocks the checkout.

bookingId.description: ID of the reservation behind the item; used to change or remove it.

createdAt.description: Time the item entered the cart.

event.description: Null when the event no longer exists.

expiresAt.description: Deadline of the reservation; the tickets are released when it passes.

lineTotal.description: Unit price times the number of tickets, from the current event data.

numberOfTickets.description: Reserved tickets of the item; set with PATCH, at most 10 per event.

unitPrice.description: Price of one ticket, from the current event data; the checkout stores the charged line.

checkoutReady.description: True when the cart has items and all of them belong to published events.

openPayment.description:
The caller's checkout that is still open, if any: its items left the cart and wait for
their payment, so the cart reports the checkout instead of letting the items vanish.

totalAmount.description:
Sum of the line totals of the items, from the current event data. The checkout computes
and stores the charged amount itself.

totalTickets.description: Total number of reserved tickets over all items.

location.description:
Address of the event; the event is linked to the stored location with this address, which is
created if there is none.

organizationId.description:
Keycloak ID or alias of the organization that owns the draft, as returned by GET /users/me.
May be omitted when the caller manages events in exactly one organization.

notifiedUsers.description:
Number of users with confirmed bookings who received a cancellation notice (EVENTHUB-291);
0 if the event had already begun.

accessible.description: Whether the place is accessible; false when omitted.

addressAddition.description: Optional detail such as venue, hall or floor.

houseNumber.description: Omitted or empty when the address has no house number.

postalCode.description: German postal code with five digits.

amount.description: Stored sum of the line amounts: the amount completing the payment would charge.

expiresAt.description: Shared deadline of the payment's reservations; the payment must complete before it.

paymentId.description: Identifies the payment; GET /payments/{paymentId} shows its items.

totalTickets.description: Reserved tickets over all items of the payment.

location.description: Null when the location of the event was deleted.

amount.description: Stored amount of the payment; null without payment.

bookingId.description: ID for GET /me/bookings/{bookingId} and the booking routes.

bookingStatus.description:
Stored booking status, except that a reservation whose expiresAt has passed by the database
clock is shown as expired. GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment shows the stored status.

cancelledBy.description:
Set when paid tickets were cancelled: organizer when the event of a confirmed and paid
booking was withdrawn, user when the user cancelled the booking after paying for it. A
booking the user cancelled stays user even if the event is withdrawn later. Omitted
otherwise, also for cart reservations and checkouts cancelled before payment.

event.description: Null when the event no longer exists.

expiresAt.description: Deadline of a live reservation; omitted otherwise.

message.description:
Human readable result of the payment process, the same text as GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment;
omitted while no payment process has been started.
message.example: Payment successful. Your booking is confirmed.

paymentStatus.description: Null while no payment process has been started.

ratingScore.description:
Score the caller gave the event of this booking; null while it is not rated yet. The rating
counts per user and event, not per booking.

refundAmount.description: Refunded amount of the payment; null without payment.

ticketsValid.description:
True only when the payment is paid, the booking is confirmed and the event is published or
completed, like ticketsValid of GET /bookings/{bookingId}/payment.

event.description: Null when the event of the booking no longer exists.

lineAmount.description: Tickets times the event price at checkout time; the charged amount of this item.

ticketsValid.description:
True only when the payment is paid, this booking is confirmed and the event takes place
or took place.

amount.description: Sum of the line amounts of the items, computed and stored by the backend only.

expiresAt.description: Deadline for completing a pending payment; omitted once the payment is completed.

message.description: Human readable result of the payment process.
message.example: Payment successful. Your tickets are confirmed.

ticketsValid.description: True only when the payment is paid and every item holds valid tickets.

organizerAlias.description: Alias of the organization that owns the event, as tokens and GET /users/me carry it.

organizerId.description: Database UUID of the organization that owns the event, as GET /organizations/{organizationID}/rating-summary expects it.

addressAddition.description: Venue, hall or floor; null when there is none.

organizerAlias.description: Alias of the organization that owns the event, as tokens and GET /users/me carry it.

organizerId.description: Database UUID of the organization that owns the event, as GET /organizations/{organizationID}/rating-summary expects it.

location.description: Address of the event; the event is linked to the stored location with this address.

BearerAuth.description: Enter "Bearer {token}" where {token} is a Keycloak access token
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
